edges.reason: Constructor argument _start is written into the startBidTime state variable.
Constructor argument _seller is written into the seller state variable.
Constructor argument _haus is written into the haus state variable.
Untrusted msg.sender is stored directly as the winning bidder address.
block.timestamp is written into lastBidTime, making auction state time dependent.
The stored lastBid value is sent to an external address during the refund.
Contract balance is divided by 20 and multiplied by 3 to derive the haus fee.
The computed hausFee local value is pushed to an external address via transfer.
The id state variable is passed as the ERC1155 token id in the winner transfer.
The id state variable is passed as the ERC1155 token id in the seller transfer.
The untrusted winning address is the recipient of the external ERC1155 transfer.
The seller address is the recipient of the external ERC1155 transfer during pull.
The remaining contract balance is sent to the seller via an external transfer.
block.timestamp, not an explicit deadline argument, decides whether bidding is open.
msg.sender is read in bid() to authorize and record the caller as winner.
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender in bid(), a fragile contract-bidder check.
block.timestamp determines whether end() may finalize the auction.
block.timestamp determines whether pull() may return the asset to the seller.
live() relies solely on block.timestamp derived window comparisons.
The lastBidTime check gates the external refund performed inside bid().
bidLength extends lastBidTime to decide whether the refund branch executes.
bid() performs an external value transfer to the previous winner before updating state.
end() performs an external ERC1155 transfer to the winner before clearing state.
end() performs an external transfer of the protocol fee to haus.
end() performs an external transfer of the full remaining balance to the seller.
pull() performs an external ERC1155 transfer to the seller before setting ended.
safeTransferFrom on an ERC1155-aware recipient can re-enter via onERC1155Received.
bid() overwrites the lastBid state variable with the accepted bid value.
end() sets the ended flag to true to block further finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only start parameter has no standalone liveness; it collapses into the constructor that persists it.
Constructor-only seller parameter is only meaningful as part of the constructor initialization.
Constructor-only haus parameter is only meaningful as part of the constructor initialization.
The balance local is a short-lived snapshot inside end() and should collapse into that function.
hausFee exists solely to feed the external haus.transfer operation and merges into it.
